answer.answer: Yes, both report 100 nm polystyrene zeta potential under matching conditions (0.3 mM NaCl, pH 7.4, 25°C) on the same instrument, so they may be compared. The values differ by 34.0 mV (-48.7 mV vs -14.7 mV), a large discrepancy that likely reflects sensitivity of zeta potential to subtle solution or sample preparation differences.
